commit_message: Implement ADR 0122 spatial audio math contracts
pr_title: Implement ADR 0122 spatial audio mixer and authoring UX
pr_body: Implements ADR 0122 in staged, validated slices. This first slice adds backend-neutral spatial-audio DTOs, runtime-only voice identity, deterministic linear/inverse attenuation, equal-power pan, 2D bypass, finite sanitization, and unit tests in engine-platform. Follow-up commits on this Draft PR will add managed backend voices, ECS synchronization, authoring schema/validation, project-Rust spatial playback, and Editor authoring UX.
